findings.highlight: the man I wanted to hug the most
findings.evidenceJa: 今アンケート取ったら抱かれたい男ナンバー１！
findings.explanation: 抱かれたい男 is the stock ranking of the man women most want to be held by or sleep with, and Nakagawa bawdily declares Haruki number one as she clings to him. 'Wanted to hug' sanitizes the sexual joke into innocent affection and weakens the deliberately unprofessional welcome.
findings.japanese:
「うおおお北原さ～ん愛してる～。
今アンケート取ったら抱かれたい男ナンバー１！」
findings.todokanai: "Ooohhh, Kitahara-san～! I love you～! You would be the man I wanted to hug the most if I had to take a questionnaire right now!"

findings.highlight: My usual pace would be faster
findings.evidenceJa: いつもは俺を早足で置いてこうとするし、何かしら俺の穴を見つけては説教を始めるのに。
findings.explanation: Ordinarily Koharu walks fast enough to try to leave Haruki behind while lecturing him. The English assigns the faster usual pace to Haruki, reversing who drives their physical rhythm and obscuring why her slow, trailing walk signals that something is wrong.
findings.japanese:
いつもは俺を早足で置いてこうとするし、
何かしら俺の穴を見つけては説教を始めるのに。
findings.todokanai: My usual pace would be faster, and she would start lecturing me the very moment she found any openings she could exploit.

findings.highlight: You two, why don't you say something!?
findings.evidenceJa: お前ら言いくるめられようとしてるだろ！？
findings.explanation: Haruki accuses Satou and Nakagawa of being on the verge of letting Koharu talk them around. The English merely asks them to speak, deleting the joke that their silence is already capitulation to her neatly prepared argument and obscuring why Haruki alone continues resisting.
findings.japanese: 「お前ら言いくるめられようとしてるだろ！？」
findings.todokanai: "You two, why don't you say something!?"
